part1_desc: 第 1–24 步：跟站长学被动语态的否定和疑问，核实发明小知识。
part2_desc: 第 25–44 步：独立判断，找出说法里的错误。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：被动语态否定句、一般疑问句与特殊疑问句。Unit 4 Inventions 主题。

steps.title: 听众来信
steps.teach_html:
发明节目播出后，听众来信了。有人问：“纸真是中国人发明的吗？会不会是美国人发明的？”

站长说：好问题！做节目要讲证据。今天咱们学被动语态的否定句和疑问句，把说法一个个核实清楚。

steps.title: 核实清单
steps.teach_html:
看这张核实清单，对的打 TRUE，错的打 FALSE：

  • 1. Paper was invented in China.（纸是在中国发明的。）TRUE
  • 2. Paper was invented in America.（纸是在美国发明的。）FALSE
  • 3. The telephone was invented by Bell.（电话是贝尔发明的。）TRUE

第2句是错的。英文里说“不是……”，否定句怎么说？下面站长教你。
steps.reading:
Fact list:
1. Paper was invented in China. (TRUE)
2. Paper was invented in America. (FALSE)
3. The telephone was invented by Bell. (TRUE)

steps.title: 否定句：wasn't / weren't
steps.teach_html:
被动语态变否定，很简单：在 was / were 后面加 not。

  • was not = wasn't（单数）
  • were not = weren't（复数）

例句：Paper wasn't invented in America.（纸不是在美国发明的。）

steps.title: 否定句例句
steps.teach_html:
再看几个否定句：

  • The telephone wasn't invented in 1800.（电话不是在1800年发明的。）
  • Cars weren't made in China at first.（汽车起初不是在中国制造的。）
  • 注意：过去分词不变，变的只是 was/were。

steps.title: 一般疑问句
steps.teach_html:
想提问“是……吗？”，把 was / were 放到句首：

  • Was paper invented in China?（纸是在中国发明的吗？）
  • Were cars made in Germany?（汽车是在德国制造的吗？）

公式：Was / Were + 主语 + 过去分词 + ?

steps.title: 简短回答
steps.teach_html:
回答这种问题，用 Yes / No + 主语 + was / wasn't：

  • — Was paper invented in China?（纸是在中国发明的吗？）
    — Yes, it was.（是的。）
  • — Was paper invented in America?
    — No, it wasn't.（不是。）

主语单数用 it，复数用 they：— Were they made in China? — Yes, they were.

steps.title: 特殊疑问句
steps.teach_html:
想问“何时、何地、何人”，把疑问词放最前面：

  • When was the telephone invented?（电话是何时发明的？）— In 1876.
  • Where was paper invented?（纸是哪里发明的？）— In China.
  • Who was paper invented by?（纸是谁发明的？）— By Cai Lun.

公式：疑问词 + was / were + 主语 + 过去分词 (+ by)?

steps.title: by 的位置
steps.teach_html:
用 who 提问“谁”的时候，by 放在句尾：

  • Who was paper invented by?（纸是谁发明的？）
  • 回答：It was invented by Cai Lun.（是蔡伦发明的。）

记住：疑问句里 by 不提前，留在尾巴上。

steps.title: 小结
steps.teach_html:
今天学的三样，记牢：

  • 否定：wasn't / weren't + 过去分词
  • 一般疑问：Was / Were + 主语 + 过去分词？回答 Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
  • 特殊疑问：When / Where / Who + was / were + 主语 + 过去分词？

下面站长带着你练，先核实那张清单。

steps.title: 先看清单
steps.teach_html:
这是核实清单。做题时对照着看：第1、3句是对的，第2句是错的。

下面站长带着你练否定和疑问。
steps.reading:
Fact list:
1. Paper was invented in China. (TRUE)
2. Paper was invented in America. (FALSE)
3. The telephone was invented by Bell. (TRUE)

steps.title: 纸不是美国发明的
steps.stem: Paper ______ invented in America.
steps.explain: Paper wasn't invented in America.

wrong_feedback.A: was 是肯定。这里要否定，用 wasn't。
wrong_feedback.C: weren't 用于复数。Paper 单数，用 wasn't。
wrong_feedback.D: isn't 是现在时。这里过去的事，用 wasn't。

steps.reading:
Fact list:
1. Paper was invented in China. (TRUE)
2. Paper was invented in America. (FALSE)
3. The telephone was invented by Bell. (TRUE)

steps.title: 汽车起初不是中国造的
steps.stem: Cars ______ made in China at first.
steps.explain: Cars weren't made in China at first.

wrong_feedback.B: wasn't 用于单数。Cars 是复数，用 weren't。
wrong_feedback.C: were 是肯定。这里要否定，用 weren't。
wrong_feedback.D: was 是单数肯定。复数否定用 weren't。

steps.title: 电话是贝尔发明的吗
steps.stem: ______ the telephone invented by Bell?
steps.help: 过去 + 单数，疑问句把 was 放句首。
steps.explain: Was the telephone invented by Bell?

wrong_feedback.A: Is 是现在时。这里问过去的事，用 Was。
wrong_feedback.B: Are 是现在时复数。用 Was。
wrong_feedback.C: Were 用于复数主语。telephone 单数，用 Was。

steps.reading:
Fact list:
1. Paper was invented in China. (TRUE)
2. Paper was invented in America. (FALSE)
3. The telephone was invented by Bell. (TRUE)

steps.title: 简短回答
steps.scene: 纸是在中国发明的吗？是的。
steps.stem: — Was paper invented in China? — ______
steps.help: 肯定回答：Yes + 主语 + was。
steps.explain: Yes, it was.

wrong_feedback.A: 时态错了。问的是 was，答也要用 was：Yes, it was。
wrong_feedback.B: 这是“No”+ 否定。题目清单第1句是 TRUE，要肯定回答。
wrong_feedback.D: they 是复数。这里主语是 paper（it），用 Yes, it was。

steps.title: 何时发明的
steps.stem: ______ was the telephone invented?
steps.explain: When was the telephone invented? — In 1876.

wrong_feedback.A: What 问“什么”。问时间用 When。
wrong_feedback.C: Where 问“哪里”。问时间用 When。
wrong_feedback.D: Who 问“谁”。问时间用 When。

steps.title: 谁发明的
steps.stem: Who ______ paper invented by?
steps.explain: Who was paper invented by? — By Cai Lun.

wrong_feedback.A: is 是现在时。这里问过去，用 was。
wrong_feedback.C: were 用于复数。paper 单数，用 was。
wrong_feedback.D: are 是现在时。这里问过去，用 was。

steps.title: 哪里发明的
steps.stem: Where ______ printing invented?
steps.explain: Where was printing invented? — In China.

wrong_feedback.B: were 用于复数。printing 单数，用 was。
wrong_feedback.C: is 是现在时。这里问过去，用 was。
wrong_feedback.D: are 是现在时。这里问过去，用 was。

steps.title: 否定回答
steps.scene: 纸是在美国发明的吗？不是。
steps.stem: — Was paper invented in America? — ______
steps.help: 清单第2句是 FALSE，要否定回答。
steps.explain: No, it wasn't.

wrong_feedback.A: 这是肯定回答。但清单说第2句是错的，要否定回答。
wrong_feedback.B: No 后面要跟否定：No, it wasn't。
wrong_feedback.D: Yes 和 wasn't 矛盾。要 No, it wasn't。

steps.title: were 的疑问
steps.stem: ______ cars made in Germany?
steps.explain: Were cars made in Germany?

wrong_feedback.B: Was 用于单数。cars 是复数，疑问句句首要用 Were。
wrong_feedback.C: Is 是现在时。这里问的是过去的事，用 Were。
wrong_feedback.D: Are 是现在时复数。这里问过去的事，用 Were。

steps.title: 改否定句
steps.stem: 改成否定句：Paper was invented in China.
steps.answer_text: Paper was not invented in China.

answers: paper was not invented in china

steps.explain: Paper was not invented in China.（wasn't 也对）

common_errors.when: 只写了 wasn't 没写句子
common_errors.say: 要写完整句子：Paper was not invented in China。
被动语态的否定不用 didn't：在 was 后面加 not——Paper was not invented in China。

common_errors.when: not 放在 was 前面
common_errors.say: not 的位置在 was 后面：was not invented，顺序别反。
was 后面要用过去分词 invented，不能用原形 invent。

steps.title: 改疑问句
steps.stem: 改成疑问句：The telephone was invented by Bell.
steps.answer_text: Was the telephone invented by Bell?

answers: was the telephone invented by bell

steps.explain: Was the telephone invented by Bell?

common_errors.say: 疑问句要把 was 放到最前面：Was the telephone invented by Bell?
被动语态的疑问句不用 did：把原句里的 was 直接提到句首就行。
was 后面是过去分词 invented，不能用原形 invent。
这句问的是“谁发明的”，by Bell 不能丢：Was the telephone invented by Bell?

steps.title: 写出过去分词：do
steps.stem: 写出 do 的过去分词。
steps.explain: do → done。

common_errors.say: 没有 doed 这种说法，记住是 done。
did 是 do 的过去式。被动语态里用的是过去分词，要写 done。
doing 是“正在做”。这里要过去分词 done。
does 是现在时的三单形式。do 的过去分词是 done。

steps.title: 简短回答
steps.stem: 回答：Was paper invented in China?（用 Yes）
steps.explain: Yes, it was.

common_errors.say: 问的是 was，回答也要用 was：Yes, it was。
简短回答里不用再重复 paper，用 it 代替：Yes, it was。
问题是用 was 问的，回答也要用 was，不能用 did：Yes, it was。

steps.title: 填 was/were
steps.stem: 填空：___ they invented in China?
steps.explain: 复数用 were。

common_errors.say: they 是复数，疑问句也用 were。
are 是现在时。这里问的是过去的事，they 用 were。
is 是单数、还是现在时。they 是复数、问的又是过去，用 were。

steps.title: 新任务：独立核实
steps.teach_html:
新任务：电灯泡 (light bulb) 是爱迪生 (Edison) 在1879年发明的，电话是贝尔在1876年发明的。

资料在上面。这次你自己核实说法，站长不提示了。

记住：否定 wasn't/weren't；疑问把 was/were 放句首。
steps.reading:
Light bulb: invented by Edison, in 1879, in America
Telephone: invented by Bell, in 1876

steps.title: 电灯泡的发明人
steps.scene: 电灯泡是爱迪生发明的。
steps.stem: The light bulb ______ invented by Edison.
steps.explain: The light bulb was invented by Edison.

wrong_feedback.A: is 是现在时。电灯泡是过去发明的，要用 was。
wrong_feedback.B: are 是现在时复数。主语 the light bulb 是一个、又是过去的事，用 was。
wrong_feedback.D: were 用在复数主语后面。the light bulb 是单数，过去时用 was。

steps.reading:
Light bulb: invented by Edison, in 1879, in America
Telephone: invented by Bell, in 1876

steps.title: 否定：电灯泡
steps.scene: 电灯泡不是贝尔发明的。
steps.stem: The light bulb ______ invented by Bell.
steps.explain: The light bulb wasn't invented by Bell.

wrong_feedback.B: weren't 是复数否定。the light bulb 是单数，否定用 wasn't。
wrong_feedback.C: was 是肯定句。可清单上写了：电灯泡不是贝尔发明的，这里要否定，用 wasn't。
wrong_feedback.D: isn't 是现在时否定。发明是过去的事，用 wasn't。

steps.reading:
Light bulb: invented by Edison, in 1879, in America
Telephone: invented by Bell, in 1876

steps.title: 电灯泡是1879年发明的吗
steps.stem: ______ the light bulb invented in 1879?
steps.explain: Was the light bulb invented in 1879?

wrong_feedback.A: Is 是现在时。问过去的事，句首要用 Was。
wrong_feedback.B: Are 是现在时、还是复数。这里单数加过去，用 Was。
wrong_feedback.C: Were 用在复数主语前面。the light bulb 是单数，用 Was。

steps.reading:
Light bulb: invented by Edison, in 1879, in America
Telephone: invented by Bell, in 1876

steps.title: 何时
steps.stem: ______ was the light bulb invented?
steps.explain: When was the light bulb invented?

wrong_feedback.A: What 问的是“什么东西”。这里问的是哪一年发明的，用 When。
wrong_feedback.C: Where 问的是“在什么地方”。问时间用 When。
wrong_feedback.D: Who 问的是“是谁”。问时间用 When。

steps.title: 否定回答
steps.scene: 电灯泡是贝尔发明的吗？不是。
steps.stem: — Was the light bulb invented by Bell? — ______
steps.explain: No, it wasn't.

wrong_feedback.A: 这是肯定回答。可电灯泡不是贝尔发明的，事实对不上，要用 No 回答。
wrong_feedback.B: No 后面不能接肯定。否定回答要说 No, it wasn't。
wrong_feedback.C: Yes 和 wasn't 互相打架。事实不对时用 No 开头：No, it wasn't。

steps.reading:
Light bulb: invented by Edison, in 1879, in America
Telephone: invented by Bell, in 1876

steps.title: 谁发明的电话
steps.stem: Who ______ the telephone invented by?
steps.explain: Who was the telephone invented by?

wrong_feedback.A: is 是现在时。电话是过去发明的，要用 was。
wrong_feedback.B: are 是现在时复数。这里过去加单数，用 was。
wrong_feedback.D: were 用在复数主语前面。the telephone 是单数，用 was。

steps.title: 写出过去分词：speak
steps.stem: 写出 speak 的过去分词。
steps.explain: speak → spoken。

common_errors.say: 记住是 spoken。
spoke 是过去式。被动语态用的是过去分词，要写 spoken。
speaking 是“正在说”。speak 的过去分词是 spoken。

steps.title: 改否定句
steps.stem: 改成否定句：They were invented in China.
steps.answer_text: They were not invented in China.

answers: they were not invented in china
cn: 它们不是在中国发明的

steps.explain: They were not invented in China.

common_errors.say: 主语是 they（复数），用 weren't：They weren't invented in China。
被动语态的否定不用 didn't：在 were 后面加 not——They were not invented in China。

common_errors.when: not 放在 were 前面
common_errors.say: not 的位置在 were 后面：were not invented。
were 后面要用过去分词 invented，不能用原形 invent。

steps.title: 改疑问句
steps.stem: 改成疑问句：Paper was invented in China.
steps.explain: Was paper invented in China?

common_errors.say: 把 was 放到最前面。
被动语态的疑问句不用 did：把原句的 was 提到最前面。
was 后面是过去分词 invented，不能用原形 invent。
语序不变只加问号不算疑问句：要把 was 提到 paper 前面——Was paper invented in China?

steps.title: 填空
steps.stem: 填空：___ was the telephone invented?
steps.explain: When was the telephone invented?

common_errors.say: 问的是时间（1876），用 When。
What 问的是“什么”。答案是 1876 年，问时间用 When。
Who 问的是“谁发明的”。这里问的是年份，用 When。
How 问的是“怎么做/怎么样”。问时间用 When。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
核实得很清楚。站长说：以后谁再乱讲发明的故事，咱们有证据反驳。

下一期，咱们看看现代的发明——电话、电灯这些东西，现在是怎么做出来的。节目预告：过去用 was/were，现在用什么？

steps.title: 挑战 · 这些车是德国造的吗
steps.scene: 预告先放一边，临走加码：把这句改成疑问句。
steps.stem: 改成疑问句：These cars were made in Germany.
steps.answer_text: Were these cars made in Germany?
steps.help: 先数主语是一个还是多个，再决定把哪个词提到句首。

answers: were these cars made in germany
cn: 这些车是德国制造的吗

steps.explain: Were these cars made in Germany?

common_errors.say: cars 是复数，疑问句要用 Were 开头，不用 Was。
被动语态的疑问句不用 did：把原句的 were 提到句首就行。
were 后面要用过去分词 made，不能用原形 make。

steps.title: 挑战 · 窗户昨天没擦
steps.stem: 改成否定句：The windows were cleaned yesterday.
steps.answer_text: The windows were not cleaned yesterday.
steps.help: 否定是在 be 动词后面动手脚，先找到这句的 be 动词。

answers: the windows were not cleaned yesterday

steps.explain: The windows were not cleaned yesterday.（weren't 也对）

common_errors.say: windows 是复数，要用 weren't / were not，不能用 wasn't。
被动语态的否定不用 didn't：在 were 后面加 not。
were 后面要用过去分词 cleaned，不能用原形 clean。

steps.title: 挑战 · 自行车的简短回答
steps.scene: 核实清单上写着：自行车不是在中国发明的。
steps.stem: — Were the bikes invented in China? — ______
steps.help: 先看问句的主语有几个、用的哪个 be 动词，回答要跟问句对上号。
steps.explain: No, they weren't.

wrong_feedback.A: 两个地方对不上：主语是 bikes（复数）要用 they；而且清单说不是在中国发明的，要用 No 回答。
wrong_feedback.C: 方向对了，但 it 是单数。bikes 是复数，否定要用 they weren't。
wrong_feedback.D: they 后面不能跟 was。复数要用 were：肯定回答是 Yes, they were。

steps.title: 挑战 · 这首歌是谁写的
steps.scene: 问这首歌的作者，只写空里的一个词。
steps.stem: Who ______ this song written by?
steps.help: 先看主语是单数还是复数，再看说的是过去还是现在。
steps.explain: Who was this song written by?

common_errors.say: song 是一首歌（单数），用 was，不用 were。
is 是现在时。这首歌是以前写出来的，问过去用 was。
被动语态不用 did 提问，空里要填 be 动词 was。

steps.title: 挑战 · 长得多
steps.scene: 这座桥比那座旧桥长得多，只写空里的一个词。
steps.stem: This bridge is much ______ than the old one.
steps.help: 后面有 than，先想“长”的比较级怎么写。
steps.explain: This bridge is much longer than the old one.

common_errors.say: long 是短词，比较级直接加 -er：longer，不能用 more long。
有 than 的地方要用比较级 longer，不能用原形 long。
longest 是最高级（最长）。这里是两座桥比，用比较级 longer。

steps.title: 挑战 · 最有用的发明
steps.scene: 在所有发明里挑第一名。
steps.stem: Of all the inventions, the computer is ______ one.
steps.help: 先看范围：是两个比，还是在一堆里挑第一？再想挑第一时前面要站着谁。
steps.explain: Of all the inventions, the computer is the most useful one.

wrong_feedback.A: useful 是原形，只能说“有用”，不能表示“最有用”。一堆里挑第一要用最高级。
wrong_feedback.B: more useful 是比较级，是两个东西比高低。这里是所有发明里挑第一，用最高级。
wrong_feedback.D: 意思对了一半：最高级前面必须加 the——the most useful。

steps.title: 挑战 · 已经参观过了
steps.scene: 我哥哥已经参观过这家工厂了，只写空里的一个词。
steps.stem: My brother ______ already visited the factory.
steps.help: 先数主语是一个还是多个，再看：表示“已经做过”时，句中站着哪个小帮手。
steps.explain: My brother has already visited the factory.

common_errors.say: 主语 my brother 是一个人（第三人称单数），要用 has，不用 have。
is 后面不能跟 visited 组成“已经做过”。表示经历要用 has + 过去分词。
did 后面要跟动词原形，不能跟 visited。这里要用 has。

steps.title: 挑战 · 她试过吗
steps.scene: 问她有没有试过这台新机器。
steps.stem: ______ she ever tried the new machine?
steps.help: 盯住 ever 和 tried 这两个词，想想哪种句型爱用它们提问。
steps.explain: Has she ever tried the new machine?

wrong_feedback.B: Does 后面要跟动词原形（try），跟不了 tried。问“做过没有”要用 Has 开头。
wrong_feedback.C: Is 后面不能直接跟过去分词 tried 表示经历。这种问法要用 Has。
wrong_feedback.D: Did 是一般过去时，后面也要跟原形 try。这里有 ever + tried，是完成时的问法，用 Has。

title: 真假发明：否定和疑问
